# What happens to the pTlib3A library once it is built.
# 30 members in the subpool, so the pick is a library: clones are named by plate address.
Pick	pTlib3A	n=30 phenotype=growing on the selective plate clone=T3A library=true vessel=48-well	pTlib3A_clones
Miniprep	pTlib3A_clones	clone=pTlib3A box=TPcon6B	pTlib3A_dna
Sequencing	pTlib3A_dna	oligo=G00101 reads=F	pTlib3A_reads
Analysis	pTlib3A_reads	expects=terminator_insert	pTlib3A_verdict
